title: The Selfish Giant (Oscar Wilde), Maison revision 3988156b-2eee-4839-b542-2d3b8b253307
period_and_place: Late-Victorian English countryside, 1880s: a grey stone castle, a walled garden with twelve peach trees (pink blossom in spring, summer green leaves, ripe golden peaches in autumn, bare frost-covered branches in winter), a dusty road, a village market
palette_and_light: spring green, blossom pink and pearl, winter silver and slate blue, honey-gold light; soft diffused daylight; each shot names its real light source (sunlight, moonlight, or a hearth fire indoors)
lens_and_look: Earnalism house style (references/visual-style.md): 2D animated feature-film illustration, appended by the job builder

characters.giant: the Giant, an enormous man three times a grown man's height, broad shoulders, ruddy weathered face, bushy brown beard, heavy brows, coarse brown woollen tunic with a wide leather belt, great boots
characters.old_giant: the Giant grown very old and feeble, the same enormous man with a long snow-white beard, thin white hair, gentle tired eyes, a grey woollen shawl over a brown tunic
characters.children: a small group of Victorian village schoolchildren aged six to ten, girls in pinafores over plain dresses, boys in caps, short jackets and boots
characters.boy: a tiny four-year-old boy with fair curly hair, bare head, pale round cheeks, an ankle-length plain white smock and small bare feet
characters.snow: the Snow, a tall pale woman in a great sweeping white cloak
characters.frost: the Frost, a thin silver-skinned sprite, small and child-sized, in a silver tunic, with a fine brush, painting the bare branches silver
characters.north_wind: the North Wind, a huge bearded man with a human face, wrapped in grey furs, cheeks puffed, blowing
characters.hail: the Hail, a lean figure dressed in a ragged grey hooded cloak, frosted breath like ice
characters.autumn: Autumn, a gentle woman in russet robes with loose auburn hair and plain bare hands, carrying a basket of golden fruit
